entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian demon and praetor, one of Yawgmoth's highest-ranking lieutenants, originally a human Thran rebel.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Dark God of Phyrexia who converted Gix into a demon and later cast him down for failure.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: The genius Thran artificer who pioneered powerstone technology, stabbed by Gix with a powerstone shard.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: Glacian's wife, a Thran architect who summoned Yawgmoth and later closed the Phyrexia portal.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A brother in the Brothers' War who became a planeswalker and eventually destroyed Gix.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's younger brother, whose Compleation Gix oversaw.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A rogue Phyrexian newt who revealed Gix's involvement and sacrificed herself to disrupt his spell.

entities.name: Ratepe
entities.description: A human who sacrificed himself with Xantcha to disrupt Gix's spell.

entities.name: Avohir
entities.description: Owner of the sanctuary beneath Pincar City from which Gix was roused.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
aliases: monks from the Monastery of Gix
entities.description: Monks whose dreams Gix took over and who reopened the portal at Koilos.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The machine-flesh beings serving Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: The ancient empire of Terisiare, fueled by powerstones, that collapsed after the Thran-Phyrexian War.

entities.name: Caves of the Damned
entities.description: A network of tunnels beneath the Thran capital, home to the outcasts of Thran society, later Koilos.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: The place where Gix lured the brothers, starting the Battle at Argoth.

entities.name: Efuan Pincar
entities.description: A small Dominarian nation targeted by Gix's final incursion.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The mechanical plane where Gix was trapped after the Thran-Phyrexian War.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane the Phyrexians sought to invade.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Mishra's stone, which protected itself and its master from Gix.

entities.name: Phyrexian Punishment Sphere
entities.description: The part of Phyrexia where Gix was tortured indefinitely.

entities.name: Thran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: The war during which Gix was converted and served Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The world-shaking war between Urza and Mishra, during which Gix manipulated both sides.

entities.name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
entities.description: A tear in the Multiverse created by the sylex blast that cut Dominaria off from Phyrexia.

events.summary: Gix, a human rebel of the Caves of the Damned, ambushes Glacian and stabs him with a powerstone shard, infecting him with phthisis.
events.quote: He stabbed Glacian with a powerstone shard

events.summary: Yawgmoth cures phthisis and coerces an oath of loyalty from Gix, pacifying his rebellion.
events.quote: vowed to serve Yawgmoth faithfully forever

events.summary: After Phyrexia's founding, Gix is among the first compleated and becomes Yawgmoth's right-hand man in the Thran-Phyrexian War.
events.quote: Gix became one of the first living beings to be Compleat ed

events.summary: After the war the Phyrexians are trapped on Phyrexia when Rebbec closes the portal.
events.quote: when the Thran architect Rebbec closed the portal connecting Phyrexia to Dominaria

events.summary: During the Brothers' War a demon enters Dominaria, takes over the monks' dreams, and announces himself as Gix at Koilos.
events.quote: then announced himself as that very same Gix.

events.summary: Gix manipulates both brothers, fails to kill Mishra because of the Weakstone, and oversees Mishra's Compleation.
events.quote: he oversaw Mishra's Compleation, bringing the younger brother fully into Phyrexia's grasp

events.summary: Gix lures both brothers to Argoth, starting the Battle at Argoth.
events.quote: He also lured both brothers to Argoth

events.summary: Urza's sylex blast wipes out both armies and forces Gix back to Phyrexia.
events.quote: forcing Gix to escape back to Phyrexia with a handful of human followers

events.summary: Yawgmoth's wrath falls on Gix after the rift cuts Phyrexia off, and Gix is cast into the Punishment Sphere.
events.quote: cast down into Phyrexia's Punishment Sphere to be tortured indefinitely

events.summary: Released after the Shard of the Twelve Worlds is destroyed, Gix commands the Phyrexian incursion into Efuan Pincar.
events.quote: Gix was placed in command of the Phyrexian incursion into the small Dominarian nation of Efuan Pincar .

events.summary: Urza destroys the sleeper agents of Gulmany, and Gix flees to Koilos for a final battle with Urza.
events.quote: Urza followed him there, and Gix engaged him in a climactic final battle.

events.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe sacrifice themselves to disrupt Gix's temporal shift, which implodes on him and annihilates him.
events.quote: causing it to implode upon Gix in a blinding inferno and annihilate him at last.
